description: YEG3D: A Canadian Benchmark LiDAR Dataset for Urban Infrastructure and 3D Scene Understanding is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Amr M. Sakr, Fiseha Birhane (University of Alberta). Overview YEG3D is a large-scale, point-wise annotated mobile laser scanning (MLS) dataset designed to support research in 3D scene understanding, semantic segmentation, autonomous driving, intelligent transportation systems, geomatics, and urban analytics. Coverage: national (CA); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
